title: Meet the cast of PH adaptation of K-drama 'Fight For My Way'
summary: The hit Korean drama "Fight For My Way" will be having a Philippine adaptation starring David Licauco, Ashtine Olviga, McCoy de Leon and Aubrey Caraan.
